reviews.title: Worst customer support I had in my life !!!
reviews.text: Due to the malfunctioning of their website I ended up booking the same flight twice. Communicated with them and got an almost immediate answer assuring me the refund of one of them in about 2weeks.. It’s been 4,5 months (!!!!) and still no refund! They did not respond to my emails for 2 months and only after I threatened them with a judicial process in court I got a short email saying they communicated with financial department and would be refunded in 2-4 working days…. well, it’s been almost 1 month since then and no money + no response to my emails again!!! AN AIR COMPANY TO AVOID !!! If something does not go right you cannot count with customer help service !!
reviews.author: Cláudia G

reviews.title: Very poor customer-service
reviews.text: I flew twice with Hunnu Air (ULN-ULG and back again). Very hard to book a valid flight on the internet so that I had to go with a local travel agency. The flight time was not made public until 1 month before departure. During this time, it was impossible to get a reply to my emails to Hunnu Air where I asked for an update on the flight schedule. I mailed Hunnu Air (Support) +5 times without any reply whatsoever. In parallel, the local travel agency did the same and sometime got a reply. Therefore, while all my emails had been received, they all were simply ignored - a complete no-go! An online-check in is not possible and there's no way to check any changes in the departure times online so that one would need to phone them (they only seem to provide support to Mongolian-speaking people) or arrive at the airport very well ahead of the scheduled departure time. In my case, one flight was delayed for 2 hours without any provided reason. Not even the ground staff was able to update the passenger when the airplane will be scheduled to take-off or if it will take off at all. On board: Cabin crew was friendly and the snack average. No TV screens. Nevertheless, if there are any other options with MIAT or Aero Mongolia, I would definitely choose one of them and would not go for Hunnu Air ever again. On top of that: super expensive fly which was definitely not worth paying for the serivce I experienced.
reviews.author: Pinga123

reviews.title: Flight to the mountains!
reviews.text: Flying in the Hunnu Air's ATR 72 provides excellent low altitude landscape observation. On this flight to Ulgii, a enroute stop was made at Ulaangom. Beautiful views of lakes and mountains along the way. Given the long flying time, the airline provided a light snack enroute, but the quality was not impressive.
reviews.author: Raintree_Thailand

reviews.title: Wonderful local airline!
reviews.text: We had wonderful clear views of the desert for our flight back to UB, after a great adventure in the Gobi. Hunnu Air provided excellent service. Efficient, professional and charming flight crew and on-time, smooth service. ATR-72 offered excellent views from low altitude.
reviews.author: Raintree_Thailand

reviews.title: Flight of fancy over the desert!
reviews.text: Flight was perfectly punctual (very early morning!). Although small ATR 72 plane, the flight was smooth and well serviced. Nice views of the Gobi enroute. No complaints!
reviews.author: Raintree_Thailand

reviews.title: Comfortable, reliable and convenient domestic airline
reviews.text: I travelled from UB to Olgii and back again last week. Hunnu Air contacted me a couple of weeks before I left to tell me that there was a change in the flight time. On the day of the flight, it said to check in 2 hours before- so I did. Everyone else was too, so that's just how it is in Mongolia! The planes left on time, the flight was smooth, the view from the windows beautiful, and there was even a small meal. I read the comments on here before I went and was panicking because I had 18 kg - but they just tell you with a smile- and then calculate how much excess you have to pay- it was about $1.50 US per kg, payable by credit card- so no problem- I had presents for the family I was visiting and lots of winter clothes, and am glad I took them all. I just wanted to let people know that you won't NOT be able to board the plane if you have more than 10kg. Happy travels!
reviews.author: kiwiinnagoyajapan

reviews.title: Good flight
reviews.text: Very good flight on this domestic airline frojm Dalanzadgad to UB. Was nervous as it states that checked baggage must not exceed 10 kg. so I had to put all the heavier items into my carry-on. Plane was clean and served a light lunch with drinks for the short flight.
reviews.author: ShilohinBC

reviews.title: Good regional airline
reviews.text: Very relaxed from check in to arrival. High wing turbo-prop plane was good - snacks were ok. 10 kg checked bag limit. flew on time both ways. Small is friendly - relaxed like most of Mongolia(ns)
reviews.author: daguerrotypeLondon

reviews.title: Delayed
reviews.text: We flew on Aug 29. The flight delayed for 2-3 hours and we lost hours to enjoy Ulan Ude and ruined the plans we had. Flight attendants don't allow you change seats even the plane is half empty. Overall, I'm happy that they are providing flights between UB and UU. In the future, hope they expand the destinations and include Huhhot.
reviews.author: Tuvshin D

reviews.title: Good service
reviews.text: Nice flight crew :) short flight. Before I need to get a car to ride to Manzhouli, it took me 24 hours to get the place, now its 2 hours flight!
reviews.author: J L

reviews.title: Great domestic service. Very helpful and cheerful
reviews.text: First time in Mongolia and first time in Mongolia. I has a very tight connection. The airline was very helpful. I actually made 2 reservations in case I could not make it, I did make it I thought I could not get any money back. I asked and they very nicely said sure... got my money back and a thank you to boot. Though their baggage fees are too high. But other than that great!
reviews.author: Wattetiparoch

reviews.title: A super little airline
reviews.text: Internal flights need hold no fear in Mongolia if you choose Hunnu. It's a small local carrier with just three aircraft - all turboprops. Ours was an ATR72, Hunnu's most recent acquisition and it seemed pretty new inside with comfortable leather seats. Baggage allowance is limited to 15kg including cabin baggage, so travel light. A fairly routine flight in good conditions and even an in-flight sandwich which looked awful but tasted pretty good - quite an achievement. No in-flight entertainment, but for a one hour flight : do you really need it? Friendly service by Mongolian standards. European regional carriers could learn a thing or two from Hunnu.
